blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and October 2026, detached houses: listings fell from 134 in June to 110 in October (−17.9%), and it took 11.9% of the city’s 464 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings fell from 137 in June to 113 in October (−17.5%), and it took 8.0% of the city’s 737 sales over the period.
The monthly write-ups singled out East Newton for detached houses in September (a buyers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in June, July (a buyers’ best bet).

blocks.text: Lots and land in East Newton
What trades here

items.t: What the ground is: A "land" purchase here is therefore normally a fee-simple house lot with an existing house on it, valued for teardown, rebuild or added units — not a vacant serviced lot in a new bare-land subdivision.

Fee-simple is the default and only verified lot form: Where a two-unit building exists, Surrey stock can be one fee-simple property or a two-lot strata under the Strata Property Act — tenure is read lot by lot on title, never assumed from the street.

Lot character — zone minimums AS THE RESEARCH STATES THEM: Surrey Zoning Bylaw No. 12000 governs; Newton zones include RA (Acreage Residential) and the R1–R6 residential series, with bylaw minimum lot areas including R1 at the 1,858 m² band, R2 at 929 m², R3 at 464 m² for a single-family home and 557 m² for a duplex, R4 at 250 m², and R5 at 200 m² for a single-family home and 225 m² for a duplex. Older larger lots sit on the acreage-residential edges. These are bylaw minimums, not a survey of lots for sale — no typical for-sale lot size is published.

ALR vs non-ALR: No ALR designation inside East Newton was confirmed on a City page; the area sits in the Serpentine River watershed uplands east of the downstream lowlands, and ALR land lies south and east of Newton generally. A specific property's ALR status is confirmed in the Agricultural Land Commission's maps — check the parcel, do not rely on the sub-area generalisation.

Serviced vs unserviced: The research documents no well/septic pocket inside East Newton; the City's SSMUH page treats properties not connected to community water and sewer as an exemption category, which is the check to run on any acreage-edge (RA) parcel — servicing for a specific lot is not confirmed until confirmed with the City.
: Silva, by Wanson Group, at 13760 75A Ave — three four-storey buildings with 261 condo homes — is the sub-area's one large new development.
Land assemblies / development sites: Nothing else is presented here as development inventory: Not confirmed beyond those two.
Market context, labelled as such: SnapStats covers Surrey, but it has NO land category — it splits Detached versus "Condos & Townhomes" combined only.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around East Newton

items.t: East Newton is in the City of Surrey, in the Newton community, covering Newton lands east of King George Boulevard; the City's East Newton plan material bounds the plan ground by King George Highway to the west, 76 Avenue to the south, 152 Street to the east and Newton Athletic Park to the north.
The board/MLS sub-area name is "East Newton," the same wording the City uses for its plan areas (East Newton North, East Newton South, East Newton Business Park).
Nearby areas: West Newton (west, across King George Boulevard), Panorama Ridge / Sullivan (south), Fleetwood Tynehead (northeast) and Cedar Hills (adjoining plan ground to the north/east).
The local neighbourhood name inside East Newton is Chimney Hill, carried by Chimney Hill Elementary and Chimney Heights Park.

The East Newton Business Park plan area (128 St to 144 St, 80 Ave to the south side of 88 Ave) sits at the north end — industrial/business-park ground, not residential lot stock; a land buyer at the north edge must check neighbouring uses against that plan context.

Transit relevant to land value: the R1 RapidBus runs on King George Boulevard between Newton Exchange and King George Station via Surrey Central Station; routes 321 (via 152 St and King George Blvd) and 324 (via 132 St) serve the grid. No SkyTrain station is inside East Newton.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in East Newton

items.t: : A bare-land strata lot IS strata tenure: the buyer owns a strata lot, and Form B, strata fees and registered bylaws apply to the lot itself.

BC strata block (applies wherever a bare-land strata lot is the purchase): Form B Information Certificate: discloses strata fees, amounts owed, approved special levies still to be paid, the CRF balance, parking/storage and an insurance summary; the strata must provide it within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page.

Depreciation reports / CRF (strata lots): Since July 1, 2024, every BC strata with five or more lots must obtain a depreciation report every five years; since November 1, 2023, annual budgets must contribute at least 10% of the operating fund to the CRF. Rental-restriction bylaws are VOID since November 24, 2022; the only valid age bylaws are 55+ bylaws under Strata Property Act ss. 123.1/123.2, with the May 1, 2023 exemptions.

ALR rules (edge parcels only — no in-area ALR confirmed): Where a parcel IS in the ALR: residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; Strata Property Act s. 239; Agricultural Land Commission Act s. 21(1)); subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; the principal residence is capped at 500 m², a secondary suite is permitted within the principal residence only, and one additional residence is permitted without an ALC application up to 90 m² on properties of 40 ha or less and up to 186 m² on properties over 40 ha, subject to City bylaws.

BC Assessment farm class (only if an edge parcel claims farm class) — full three-tier form: Gross annual value of at least $2,500 where the farm area is 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 plus 5% of the actual value of the area over 4 ha where the area exceeds 4 ha; $10,000 where the area is under 0.8 ha — with the application delivered to the assessor on or before October 31. A flat "$2,500+" statement is an error and is not used here.

First-home-on-land programs — stated precisely: The First-Time Home Buyers' GST rebate (Bill C-4, Royal Assent March 13, 2026, per CRA News No. 122) rebates 100% of GST to $1 million (maximum $50,000), phasing out to $1.5 million, for agreements March 20, 2025–2031 — but it applies to new HOUSING, not to bare land itself; a land-only purchase does not attract it. The older GST New Housing Rebate is 36% of GST, maximum $6,300, phasing out $350,000–$450,000. Home Buyers' Plan: up to $60,000 from an RRSP. First Home Savings Account: $8,000/year, $40,000 lifetime. Whether a combined land-plus-build arrangement qualifies for housing rebates is transaction-specific: Not confirmed per transaction.

blocks.text: Good to know about East Newton

items.t: The plan documents most sellers quote no longer govern. East Newton North was rescinded and East Newton South's designations superseded by the Surrey 2050 OCP (Bylaw No. 21900, adopted June 15, 2026) — a lot priced on an old NCP density is priced on a repealed plan.

The 6-unit tier is a bus-stop test, not a neighbourhood promise. It needs an eligible lot of at least 281 m² within 400 m of a frequent bus stop — two lots on the same street can fall on opposite sides of that line.
McLeod Road Traditional is the correct school name (6325 142 St, at the Panorama Ridge edge) — shortened or reordered variants in listing copy are errors.
Serpentine is a board sub-area, not a land fact.

blocks.text: Duplexes and half duplexes in East Newton
Local rules that affect duplexes in East Newton

items.t: Zoning, SSMUH and suites (Surrey): The City's zoning allows a maximum of 3 units on lots smaller than 280 m², 4 units on lots larger than 280 m², and up to 6 units on eligible lots of at least 281 m² within 400 m of a frequent bus stop; the BC Building Code permits one secondary suite per house; properties not connected to community water and sewer are among the exemptions. A secondary suite in Surrey is capped at 40% of the principal habitable area — Surrey's own cap, never borrowed. The City states the SSMUH changes do not retroactively legalize a secondary suite or coach house built without permits — an existing unpermitted suite still needs the permit and approval process, so suite permits are verified on any East Newton listing.

Flood and ALR note: No floodplain or ALR designation inside East Newton was confirmed on a City page; the area sits in the Serpentine River watershed uplands east of the downstream lowlands the City's flood page covers, and ALR land lies south and east of Newton generally — a specific property's ALR status is confirmed in the Agricultural Land Commission's maps.

faq.q: Can I actually buy a vacant lot in East Newton?
faq.a: Rarely as a new-subdivision lot — the research verifies no bare-land subdivision here. The realistic purchase is a fee-simple house lot (usually with a house on it) bought for rebuild or added units, or Business Park ground at the north end.

faq.q: How many units can my lot hold?
faq.a: Under Surrey's SSMUH framework: 3 units on lots under 280 m², 4 on lots over 280 m², and up to 6 on eligible lots of 281 m² or more within 400 m of a frequent bus stop — confirm the lot's size band and bus-stop eligibility with the City before valuing it.

faq.q: Is the lot serviced — water and sewer, or well and septic?
faq.a: Most subdivision ground is on community services; acreage-edge (RA) parcels need a specific check, because properties not connected to community water and sewer are an SSMUH exemption category. Servicing for a specific lot: Not confirmed until the City confirms it.

faq.q: What does it cost to subdivide or develop?
faq.a: The City's process runs through detailing and a Servicing Agreement that sets the off-site works, services and financial securities for final approval. No City source states a dollar figure for this area — any servicing/DCC number quoted without a City estimate for the specific parcel is not confirmed.

faq.q: Is my lot in the ALR or a floodplain?
faq.a: No in-area ALR or floodplain designation was confirmed; the uplands sit east of the Serpentine lowlands. Check the parcel on the ALC maps and the City's flood mapping before subjects.

faq.q: Is there a duplex development in East Newton I can buy into?
faq.a: What is verified is the form class — individual duplexes on single lots, with Bylaw 12000 itself setting duplex minimum lot areas in R3 (557 m²) and R5 (225 m²).

faq.q: How do I know which kind of duplex I am buying?
faq.a: From the title, not the listing: A fee-simple duplex is one title with no strata fees or bylaws; a strata duplex is two strata lots with monthly fees, bylaws and shared insurance under the Strata Property Act.

faq.q: What lot size do I need for a duplex?
faq.a: Under Bylaw 12000: R3 needs 557 m² for a duplex (464 m² for a single-family home) and R5 needs 225 m² for a duplex (200 m² for a single-family home); R1 sits at the 1,858 m² band and R2 at 929 m², with older larger lots on the acreage-residential edges.

SD36 schools in the area are Chimney Hill and M.B. Sanford elementary schools, and Tamanawis and Panorama Ridge secondary schools; the assigned school for a specific address is set through the SD36 School Locator.
The R1 RapidBus on King George Boulevard links Newton Exchange and King George Station via Surrey Central Station, and routes 321 and 324 run through the Newton street grid.
